sloka: अश्वयुक्तो रथो मह्यमुत्तिष्ठेत्तु विभावसोः ।तत्स्थस्यामरता स्यान्मे एष मे निश्चयो वरः ।। ७.३०.१५ ॥
transliteration: aśvayukto ratho mahyamuttiṣṭhettu vibhāvasoḥ ।tatsthasyāmaratā syānme eṣa me niścayo varaḥ ।। 7.30.15 ॥

translations.english: My best resolve is that a horse-yoked chariot of the sun should rise for me, and immortality should be granted to one standing on it.
